title: ECB archive download mechanism
description: The source requires fetching the ECB ZIP archive and tests must stub the download, but does not prescribe a transport or extraction library. Use Python standard-library HTTP and ZIP facilities to keep the dependency surface small and make download replacement straightforward.

options.label: Add a third-party HTTP or archive package

title: Indexes derived from the persistence declaration
description: The rendered schema indexes rates(currency, date). Each is implied by the declaration — a foreign key is looked up by its child column, and a read pattern's Input fields are the predicate it filters on. Declare an `- INDEX (...)` bullet in DATABASE.md for any index this does not cover.
